children: may bounce to $5,766 per metric ton, as it has found a strong support at $5,529.

Considering that the former support at $5,776, the 61.8% retracement of the uptrend from $5,130 to $6,821, triggered a decent bounce, the support at $5,529 may cause another one, as this support is strengthened by a similar support at $5,533.
A break below $5,529 may open the way toward the $5,130-$5,360 range.
* The cocoa report is published every Wednesday and Friday.
